description: Compile a finite discrete queue with explicit arrivals, service/storage capacity, schedule and units, then check overflow through existing dynamics. All declared arrival combinations within the schedule are considered.

arrivals.description: Alternative arrival counts for EACH time slot; every combination is considered

quantity_unit.description: Discrete conserved unit, e.g. requests or packets

schedule.description: Specifies exactly when storage overflow is checked

service_capacity.description: Maximum units served per time slot

time_unit.description: Duration represented by one synchronous queue step, e.g. '1 ms'

name: triz_queue
